candidates.reason: Uses a window count and DISTINCT to retain one row per hour, including the NULL group, with BIGINT counts.
candidates.sql: SELECT DISTINCT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime)) AS trips FROM trips

candidates.reason: Counts each distinct pickup timestamp before aggregating by hour. The explicit cast preserves COUNT's BIGINT type.
candidates.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM pickup_datetime) AS hour, CAST(SUM(timestamp_trips) AS BIGINT) AS trips FROM (SELECT tpep_pickup_datetime AS pickup_datetime, COUNT(*) AS timestamp_trips FROM trips GROUP BY tpep_pickup_datetime) AS timestamp_counts GROUP BY EXTRACT(hour FROM pickup_datetime)
